title: Kaizen Crypto | Cardano 101 Course Video Lessons Translated To Popular Languages

ms.promise:
As per reviewer request, the final course will include 35 video lessons that encompass the fundamentals of understanding Cardano. Topics include PoW v. PoS, the Blockchain Trilemma, eUTXO, and many other topics. Please reference the current Youtube Playlist on the Kaizen Crypto youtube channel for additional supporting details. Our plan for the course is to create a high-quality format of educational material to help onboard new users. 
・Completion of Spanish Translations (35 video scripts)
・Completion of Hindi Translations (35 video scripts)
・Completion of Japanese Translations (35 video scripts)
ms.criteria: All video lesson scripts will be translated into Spanish and Hindi and Japanese. Translations will be publicly available to view via Google Drive. There will be 35 translated scripts for each of the mentioned languages. We have currently published 15 completed lessons for the Cardano 101 course with a positive reaction from the community. Please reference the Kaizen Crypto youtube channel, these videos are all available to view for free.
